create_CustomBatchLogger: create a CustomBatchLogger instance with configurable flush_lock, batch_size, and flush_interval parameters
run_periodic_flush: run the periodic_flush coroutine to periodically flush the log queue at a configured interval
build_flush_queue: build a flush_queue coroutine that acquires the flush_lock, sends the batch, and clears the log queue
refactor_async_send_batch: refactor the async_send_batch method to send the queued log events to an external storage system
test_flush_queue: test the flush_queue coroutine to verify it clears the log queue and calls async_send_batch
